description: This file provides a utility class for extracting the client's IP address from an HTTP request by checking various HTTP headers common in proxy or load-balanced environments.

classes.name: GeoLocationUtils
classes.description: Utility class for retrieving client's IP address from HTTP requests, considering various headers set by proxies.

methods.name: getClientIpAddress
methods.description: Returns the client's IP address by inspecting various HTTP headers, falling back to the remote address if necessary.
